video_title: LeBron, Bronny, Austin Reaves vs. Bob Does Sports | 3v3 Rematch

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his interest in YouTube golf content
quotes.excerpt: I didn't watch nothing but YouTube golf last year.
quotes.quote: I didn't watch nothing but YouTube golf last year. We were sitting on the bus and you were like, 'Yo, you should watch Grant Horvat and the Bryan Bros.' And then when I watched Grant Horvat, y'all popped up on one of the things, and I just started going down a rabbit hole, like TikTok type shit. And you get stuck on that shit, you just start going down a rabbit hole, and that's what happened.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his improved golf game
quotes.excerpt: I feel so much better in my game today compared to Scotland already.
quotes.quote: I feel so much better in my game today compared to Scotland already. In like less than two months, I just feel more balanced. It's just fun. I literally went from saying the other day, 'Who the fuck decided to start a golf channel?' to now saying, 'This is fun.' That is golf for you.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on LeBron James's influence on his golf game
quotes.excerpt: I'm home with a couple of my friends and I think he called me or something.
quotes.quote: I remember after my rookie year, I'm home with a couple of my friends and I think he called me or something, and I picked up, I look at my phone and I'm like, 'Oh, LeBron is calling me.' And they were like, 'That's fucking crazy.' And I was like, 'What do you mean?' I never really thought about it. And they were like, 'He's calling you.' I was like, 'Oh yeah.' They were like, 'That's fucking insane.' Even on the road, it is a different traveling with him. Everything is literally everything is different. You never don't have eyes on you. It's always on you.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on advice from Bryson DeChambeau
quotes.excerpt: He said, 'Stop being a bitch without saying stop being a bitch.'
quotes.quote: I like the video where Bryson was telling you just to fucking swing hard. He said, 'Stop being a bitch without saying stop being a bitch.' It works for like two holes and then I shanked one on the third one. And then your mind started spinning. It was over. That happens quick.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on the consistency of Bob Does Sports content
quotes.excerpt: We're very consistent with our uploads. Like for years, we've always uploaded at the same time.
quotes.quote: We're very consistent with our uploads. Like for years, we've always uploaded at the same time, the same day, and haven't missed. We're just very consistent with how often we, you know, will put out a video, and then the fans know when to expect it, when to get it, and I think that's something that we've been really good at doing. You know, once they miss, they go on to something new, and then if they like the new stuff that they get, they're gone. They're gone. That's how I think of it.
